abstract: Voters in multiparty systems often fail to coordinate on majority-preferred parties. Using constituency-level election data linked to party-ideology measures across 96 countries, we show that in 20–30% of multiparty elections since 1940 the Condorcet winner does not win, and in roughly 10% the winner is the Condorcet loser. Failures are most common under plurality rule and in fragmented, volatile party systems, and systematically disadvantage opposition and culturally liberal parties while benefiting organizationally strong ones. Can information fix this? In four pre-registered experiments around Indian elections (N > 4,000), constituency-level polls shift voting intentions by at most 2 percentage points, a precisely estimated null, despite modest belief updating, though undecided voters become 7 points more likely to support a viable party. A model with expressive motives rationalizes both results: polls refine beliefs but lack the leverage to overcome entrenched attachments, identifying boundary conditions on polls as coordination devices.
abstract_zh: 在多党制中，选民往往难以协调支持多数偏好的政党。通过将96个国家的选区级选举数据与政党意识形态指标相关联，我们发现自1940年以来，20%至30%的多党选举中孔多塞胜者未能获胜，约10%的选举中胜者实为孔多塞败者。此类失败在单一选区制、碎片化且不稳定的政党体系中最为常见，并系统性地不利于反对党及文化自由主义政党，而有利于组织力量强大的政党。信息能否解决这一问题？在围绕印度选举开展的四项预注册实验中（样本量>4000），选区级民调对投票意向的影响至多为2个百分点——这一精确估计的零效应，尽管存在适度的信念更新，但未决选民支持可行政党的概率提升了7个百分点。一个包含表达性动机的模型可同时解释这两项结果：民调虽能修正信念，却缺乏克服根深蒂固依附关系的杠杆作用，从而界定了民调作为协调机制的条件边界。
title: Majority Lost: Global Evidence and Field Experiments on Electoral Miscoordination

abstract: News aggregators are among the primary gatekeepers of online news, shaping both consumption and production through the algorithms that rank stories and sources. We provide the first large scale estimates of this algorithmic power using the example of Yandex News, Russia’s largest aggregator. Combining archived front pages with 12.3 million published articles and outlet-level traffic data, we estimate that occupying the entire top-5 news block for a day raises an outlet’s traffic by roughly 380,000 visitors. After a 2016 law made aggregators liable for cited content, Yandex halved its references to independent outlets, yet consumers did not penalize the manipulation: its referrals converted readers at the same rate, and its market share did not fall. Removed outlets shifted toward longer articles and stopped optimizing headlines for the algorithm, showing that aggregator algorithms shape not only news consumption but also production.
abstract_zh: 新闻聚合器是在线新闻的主要守门人，通过排序报道和来源的算法，同时塑造新闻消费与生产。我们以俄罗斯最大的聚合器Yandex News为例，首次大规模估算了这种算法的影响力。结合存档首页、1230万篇已发表文章以及媒体层面的流量数据，我们估算出，占据前五名新闻板块一整天可使一家媒体的流量增加约38万访客。2016年一项法律要求聚合器对引用的内容负责后，Yandex将独立媒体的引用量减半，但消费者并未惩罚这种操纵：其引荐的读者转化率保持不变，市场份额也未下降。被移除的媒体转向发布更长的文章，并停止为算法优化标题，这表明聚合器算法不仅塑造新闻消费，也影响新闻生产。
title: Platform Power in News Aggregation

abstract: In multi-winner elections, the goal is to select a pre-given size committee of members from a given set of candidates. We define the concept of T-power of a majority-group of voters (Total majority-power or Total tyranny-power) as the ability of the group to guarantee, under a given voting rule, that all the committee members belong to its favorite candidates, regardless of the preferences of the other voters. In this case, we say also that such a voting rule is exposed to T-power. This situation can be considered extreme and worrying in democracy. In this paper, we examine the T-power under classes of multi-winner scoring rules. We focus on some common rules, and it turns out that BLOC rule ( k - k -Approval) is totally exposed to T-power, that is, any majority-group of any size has T-power under this rule. On the other hand, CCR, k -Plurality and k -Inverse-Plurality rules are almost notexposed to it, that is, no majority of any size has T-power. These last rules may provide some protection for minority groups in the sense of preventing T-power.
abstract_zh: 在多赢家选举中，目标是从给定候选人集合中选出预先设定规模的委员会成员。我们定义多数选民群体的T-权力（总多数权力或总暴政权力）为：在给定投票规则下，该群体能够确保所有委员会成员均来自其偏好的候选人，而无论其他选民的偏好如何。在此情况下，我们也称该投票规则暴露于T-权力之下。这种情形在民主制度中可被视为极端且令人担忧。本文研究了多赢家计分规则类别下的T-权力。我们聚焦于若干常见规则，发现BLOC规则（k-k-批准制）完全暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体在此规则下均拥有T-权力。另一方面，CCR、k-复数制与k-逆复数制规则几乎不暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体均不拥有T-权力。这些规则在防止T-权力意义上可能为少数群体提供一定保护。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The T-power of a majority under multi-winner scoring rules

abstract: As populations in rich countries age and fewer youngsters enter the labour force, employers and politicians bemoan labour ‘shortages’. This column turns to historical evidence to highlight why governments should learn to love labour shortages. Between 1792 and 1815, as Britain and France fought each other for global dominance, more than one out of every ten British men ended up in the army or navy, resulting in acute labour shortages and upward pressure on wages. The authors show how this labour scarcity and a skill abundance complemented each other in driving technology diffusion, boosting British productivity in the long run.
abstract_zh: 随着富裕国家人口老龄化及年轻劳动力减少，雇主和政界人士纷纷抱怨劳动力"短缺"。本文通过历史证据揭示政府为何应学会拥抱劳动力短缺。1792年至1815年间，当英法为争夺全球霸权而战时，超过十分之一的英国男性最终服役于陆军或海军，导致严重劳动力短缺并推高工资水平。作者论证了这种劳动力稀缺与技能充裕如何相互促进，推动技术扩散，最终在长期内提升了英国的生产率。
authors: Bruno Caprettini, Alex Trew, Hans-Joachim Voth

abstract: he Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM) rests on the premise that one carbon credit compensates for one tonne of emissions. While a growing body of evidence questions the integrity of many credits, much less is known about whether the ability to offset affects firms’ incentives to reduce their own emissions. Using a buyer-linked dataset covering the near-universe of offset retirements, we exploit the 2023 carbon-market scandals as a quasi-natural experiment. Firms that stop offsetting after the shock reduce their operational (Scope 1) emissions substantially more than firms that continue to purchase offsets. This finding is consistent with moral licensing: access to offsets weakens firms’ incentives to undertake internal abatement. We also document persistent oversupply, opaque intermediation, and sharp price and volume responses to the scandals. Our results identify a demand-side problem in the VCM that is distinct from concerns about credit quality: even when credits represent genuine emissions reductions, the option to offset may slow decarbonization within purchasing firms.
abstract_zh: 自愿碳市场（VCM）建立在“一个碳信用抵消一吨排放”的前提之上。尽管越来越多的证据对许多碳信用的真实性提出质疑，但关于抵消能力是否会影响企业减排动机的研究仍十分有限。利用覆盖近乎全部碳信用注销的买方关联数据集，我们将2023年碳市场丑闻作为准自然实验。研究发现，在冲击发生后停止碳抵消的企业，其运营排放（范围一）的减少幅度显著高于继续购买碳抵消的企业。这一发现与道德许可效应一致：碳抵消的可获得性削弱了企业开展内部减排的动机。我们还发现市场存在持续供应过剩、中介环节不透明，以及丑闻引发的价格与交易量剧烈波动。我们的研究揭示了VCM中一个区别于碳信用质量问题的需求侧困境：即使碳信用代表真实的减排量，抵消选项也可能减缓购买企业的脱碳进程。
title: An Autopsy of the Voluntary Carbon Market

abstract: It often appears self-evident that regional integration arrangements (RIAs) result in more far-reaching liberalization of intra-bloc trade than is possible if countries restrict themselves to a multilateral approach. This paper considers whether such arrangements do in fact imply, or facilitate, greater liberalization of trade flows among member countries than that achieved (or sought) in the multilateral (GATT) context. The underlying hypothesis is that the political-economy forces that block far-reaching liberalization in the multilateral context also remain robust and largely decisive in sculpting RIAs. The holes and loopholes - exceptions, sectoral exclusions, market-sharing arrangements and escape clauses of various kinds - embodied in major RIAs are examined to assess the degree to which existing RIAs have achieved liberalization beyond the prevailing multilateral trade policy regime. A number of lessons regarding the likely prevalence of, and scope for, holes and loopholes in alternative types of RIAs are drawn from the historical overview.
abstract_zh: 区域一体化安排（RIAs）往往看似不言而喻地能比各国局限于多边方式时实现更深入的区域内贸易自由化。本文探讨此类安排是否确实意味着或促进了成员国之间比多边（GATT）框架下所实现（或寻求）的更大程度的贸易自由化。其基本假设是：在多边背景下阻碍深度自由化的政治经济力量，在塑造区域一体化安排时同样强劲且具有决定性作用。本文考察了主要区域一体化安排中存在的漏洞与缺口——包括例外条款、部门排除、市场分割安排及各类逃避条款——以评估现有区域一体化安排超越现行多边贸易政策体制所实现的自由化程度。基于历史回顾，本文就不同类型区域一体化安排中漏洞与缺口的可能普遍性及范围得出了若干启示。

abstract: This paper challenges the widespread view that forward exchange premia contain little information regarding subsequent spot rate movements. Using weekly dollar/Deutschmark and dollar/sterling data, we show that spot and forward exchange rates are well represented by a vector error correction model and that the vector of forward premia form a basis for the cointegrating space. Dynamic forecasts indicate that the information in the forward premia can be used to reduce the root mean squared forecast error for the spot rate (relative to a random walk forecast) by at least 33% at a six-month horizon and by between 50% and 90% at a one-year horizon.
abstract_zh: 本文挑战了普遍认为远期升水对后续即期汇率变动几乎不包含信息的观点。基于美元/德国马克和美元/英镑的周度数据，我们证明即期汇率与远期汇率可由向量误差修正模型良好刻画，且远期升水向量构成协整空间的一组基。动态预测表明，远期升水中的信息可将即期汇率均方根预测误差（相对于随机游走预测）在六个月期至少降低33%，在一年期降低50%至90%。

abstract: The paper analyses tax and tariff policy for trade between economies which each contain a monopolistically competitive industry producing differentiated products. The consequences of tax changes by a single country are examined, and the general desirability of taxing imports more heavily than domestically produced goods is established. Customs union theory is analysed by studying coordinated tax changes by a group of countries; circumstances under which customs union formation and enlargement will benefit members are found. Game theoretic techniques are used to investigate which countries will coalesce into a customs union.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了各经济体均包含一个生产差异化产品的垄断竞争行业时的税收与关税政策。研究考察了单一国家税收变动的后果，并确立了进口商品税负高于国内生产商品的普遍合理性。通过研究一组国家协调税收变动，分析了关税同盟理论；发现了关税同盟形成与扩大将使成员国受益的条件。运用博弈论方法探究了哪些国家会联合形成关税同盟。
